title: View of Bandung
provenance: Acquired by the estate of Tan Hock Seng in 1965 from an unknown Southeast Asian dealer. Later sold to Mdm. Ling Yee Kiong in 1982 and then purchased by Hwa Meng Art Gallery in 1997. Finally, it was acquired by Meridian Fine Arts Auctioneers' founder, Mr. Ng Wei Lun, in 2003 for his private collection before being put up for auction in 2022.
